title: Evidence with UTC date and trusted timestamp (PLANNED, v1)
description: DESIGN ONLY. MacGuard Cloud does not exist. An evidence record binds the SHA-256 of an audit result, baseline or attestation to a UTC date and to an independent time proof. Primary time proof: RFC 3161 (a TSA signs the hash and its own clock). Reason: it is an open standard verifiable offline with common tools, it needs only the hash (no tenant data leaves), and it does not depend on a public log. A Sigstore Rekor entry time may be added when the artefact is public, but is not sufficient for tenant evidence because Rekor is a public log.

sha256.description: Hash of the canonical subject document.

recorded_utc.description: Service clock; informational. The trusted time is trusted_timestamp.gen_time.

chain_previous_sha256.description: Hash of the previous evidence record of the tenant (append-only chain).
